name: Shilki
title: Son of Manasseh and King of Judah
summary: Shilki (also known as Shallum) was the son of King Manasseh and father of King Josiah. He is mentioned in the list of kings of Judah as part of the lineage between Manasseh and the great reformer king Josiah. In the Books of Kings, he is better known by the name Amon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shilki is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Manasseh and a link in the royal lineage of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Amon Becomes King of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shilki, known as Amon, became king of Judah at the age of twenty-two and reigned for two years in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Walked in His Father's Sinful Ways
keyEvents.description: Amon followed in his father Manasseh's sinful footsteps and worshipped the idols that his father had served.

keyEvents.title: Conspiracy and Murder
keyEvents.description: Amon's officials conspired against him and killed him in his own house after only two years of reign.

keyEvents.title: The people make Josiah king
keyEvents.description: The people of the land struck down all who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah king in his place.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: 2 Chronicles repeats the account of Amon's short and wicked reign and his violent end.
